units.source_text: 太吉郎的父亲太吉兵卫，生前常常偷偷观察太吉郎作画。

en.t: Taikichiro's father, Taikichibei, often secretly watched Taikichiro painting while he was alive.

units.source_text: 太吉郎没有像公司内的图案专家或公司外的画家那样画些时兴的花样。

en.t: Taikichiro did not draw fashionable patterns like the company's design specialists or outside painters did.

units.source_text: 所以，当太吉兵卫知道太吉郎没有天才，难以进步，

en.t: So when Taikichibei realized that Taikichiro had no genius and would have difficulty improving,

units.source_text: 并想借助麻药的魔力绘出奇怪的友禅画稿时，

en.t: and that he was trying to use the magic power of narcotics to draw strange Yuzen designs,

units.source_text: 他马上把太吉郎送进了医院。

en.t: he immediately had Taikichiro admitted to a hospital.
